title: Final offline store export QA certificate
validated_scope: Every original asset, authored hull and physical placement preserved through visual-context preparation.
Every source visual context object represented by an independent placement, with exactly 39 text-to-mesh conversions; only 42 proven zero-area canonical glyph faces removed.
Actual reopened PBR scene retains source visibility, source light data and the separately excluded preview sun.
All final FBX/texture hashes match the fresh-Blender round-trip and pixel-review reports; manifest coverage, NoCollision policy and source lineage reconciled.
Every one of 336 canonical material slots maps to a supported offline material plan with verified texture bytes and explicit UV/normal settings.
scope_limits: Unreal import/UCX cooking, engine material creation or shader compilation, first-hit sphere targeting, Character root-capsule movement, multiplayer, performance and photometric equivalence have not been run.
FBX numeric units and candidate axis mapping require the provided calibration fixture in the actual target Unreal project.
Matched-camera Cycles diagnostics are supporting low-resolution evidence, not full-resolution or Unreal render parity.
This certificate binds export files and evidence before archive publication; final archive reconstruction and publication are separate packaging steps.
